import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Prac {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = scanner.nextInt();
        int b = scanner.nextInt();
        int[] arr = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            arr[i] = scanner.nextInt();
        }
        int count = 0;
        int segmentStart = 0;
        int evenCount = 0, oddCount = 0;
        List<Integer> segmentDiffs = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (arr[i] % 2 == 0) {
                evenCount++;
            } else {
                oddCount++;
            }
            if (evenCount == oddCount && i != n - 1) {
                int diff = Math.abs(arr[i + 1] - arr[segmentStart]);
                segmentDiffs.add(diff);
                segmentStart = i + 1;
                evenCount = 0;
                oddCount = 0;
            }
        }
        if (segmentDiffs.size() > 0) {
            Collections.sort(segmentDiffs);
            int total = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < segmentDiffs.size(); i++) {
                total += segmentDiffs.get(i);
                if (total > b) {
                    count = i;
                    break;
                } else {
                    count = i + 1;
                }
            }
        } else {
            if (n > 0) {
                int diff = Math.abs(arr[0] - arr[0]);
                if (diff >= b) {
                    count = 1;
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(count);
    }
}
